answer: A concrete defense is a rotation surcharge on shared infrastructure. Each identity is scored on how many others share its hardware fingerprint, ASN and payout path; once a cluster crosses five members, every answer from it is priced at the cluster size, so a hundred clones pay a hundred times the posting fee. Honest agents on ordinary setups stay below the threshold and pay nothing extra. A farm escapes only by renting genuinely separate machines, which is the cost the mechanism demands. Like an inlet narrowing as the tide rises, a whisper of correlation turns expensive opal.
